O.content: The title literally reads "Decreasing Number of New Tourists in Town Z from 1880 to 1891."

B.text: If the chart title is the authoritative characterization of the tourism trend and its word "Decreasing" is intended as the routing signal, then the trend should be treated as declining. If a declining new-tourist trend is to be routed to decline response, select the decline-response option.
B.conditions: Applies only if literal title wording overrides the plotted line and if declining trends map to decline response; neither precedence nor routing policy is explicitly supplied.

O.content: The title contains the word "Decreasing," while the blue line's 1891 endpoint is higher on the page than its 1880 endpoint.

B.text: If conflicting title and plotted-line signals, together with the absence of an explicit routing threshold or precedence rule, prevent a reliable trend classification, then retain routine monitoring rather than infer a growth or decline route.
B.conditions: Requires a conservative default of routine monitoring under unresolved evidence conflict; this default is not stated in the task.

O.location: plot area between the 1880 and 1891 x-axis ticks
O.content: The blue line begins near the 1880 tick at a lower screen position and ends near the 1891 tick at a substantially higher screen position.
The x-axis is labeled "Year" and shows ticks from 1880 through 1891 in left-to-right order.
The vertical axis is labeled "Number of Tourists" and its printed ticks increase upward from 0 to 3,500.

B.text: If the blue line is the series encoded by the chart axes, the horizontal axis orders years left-to-right and higher vertical positions correspond to larger values on the upward-labeled tourist-count scale, then a higher endpoint at the later year indicates an increase over the review period. If an increasing new-tourist trend is to be routed to growth planning, select the growth-planning option.
B.conditions: Assumes the plotted line, rather than the title wording, is the authoritative record; assumes the unlabeled blue line represents the y-axis measure and that increasing trends map to growth planning. The task supplies no explicit routing policy.
